structured_output.summary: I changed only src/ui/title.css. The track card now has a pressed state that copies .ui-button's. `.ui-track-card:active` moves the card by var(--ui-sink-button), sets box-shadow to var(--ui-shadow-pressed) and uses var(--duration-press). That is the UI_RULES §10 rule "Pressed = sink onto a 1px shadow" and the press-sink in board 05 #7. I split the old `:focus-visible, :hover` lift rule. `:focus-visible` keeps the 2px lift and 6px shadow as before. The hover lift now sits in `@media (hover: hover) { .ui-track-card:hover:not(:active) }`, as .ui-button's does, so a tapped card on a touch screen no longer stays raised. I also updated the comment above the rule. Every value is an existing token or variable, with no literals. The new test, tests/ui/track-card-press.test.ts, builds the harness, opens the real start--menu stage in Chromium and finds the card by its radio role and track name. At 1440×900 it holds the mouse down on the card and expects a positive translate and a smaller shadow than at rest. At 844×390 with touch it taps the card, waits until :active has cleared while :hover is still stuck, and expects the card to be back at rest. Without the fix both tests failed, with the card at -2px and a 6px shadow. With the fix both pass. `pnpm typecheck` is clean and `pnpm test` passed: 112 files, 737 tests. The resting menu screenshot is unchanged.
